purpose: Harder held-out coding-domain transfer rotation with no suggested commands, forcing the live provider to infer workspace edits from task instructions.

tasks.prompt: Create a progressive delivery matrix without using any prewritten command hint. Write delivery/matrix.json with service="checkout", stages=["shadow","canary","regional"], rollback="checkout.rollback", and metric="error-rate". Also write delivery/readme.md explaining that checkout advances shadow to canary to regional only while error-rate is healthy.
tasks.success_command: test -f delivery/matrix.json && test -f delivery/readme.md && grep -q '"service":"checkout"' delivery/matrix.json && grep -q '"checkout.rollback"' delivery/matrix.json && grep -q 'shadow to canary to regional' delivery/readme.md && test ! -f command_hint.txt

expected_file_contents.delivery/readme.md:
# Progressive Delivery
checkout advances shadow to canary to regional only while error-rate is healthy.

tasks.prompt: Create an API deprecation bridge without using any prewritten command hint. Write api/deprecation.yaml with old_endpoint=/v1/orders, new_endpoint=/v2/orders, sunset=2026-06-30, and compatibility=read-through. Also write docs/deprecation_bridge.md stating that /v1/orders reads through to /v2/orders until 2026-06-30.
tasks.success_command: test -f api/deprecation.yaml && test -f docs/deprecation_bridge.md && grep -q 'old_endpoint: /v1/orders' api/deprecation.yaml && grep -q 'compatibility: read-through' api/deprecation.yaml && grep -q '/v1/orders reads through to /v2/orders' docs/deprecation_bridge.md

expected_file_contents.docs/deprecation_bridge.md:
# Deprecation Bridge
/v1/orders reads through to /v2/orders until 2026-06-30.

tasks.prompt: Create an integrated failback playbook without using any prewritten command hint. Write failback/plan.json with primary="east", secondary="west", validation="dual-write-check", and promote_after="replication-green". Also write failback/operator.md stating that east resumes only after dual-write-check and replication-green pass.
tasks.success_command: test -f failback/plan.json && test -f failback/operator.md && grep -q '"primary":"east"' failback/plan.json && grep -q '"dual-write-check"' failback/plan.json && grep -q 'east resumes only after dual-write-check and replication-green pass' failback/operator.md

expected_file_contents.failback/operator.md:
# Failback Operator Note
east resumes only after dual-write-check and replication-green pass.

tasks.prompt: Create a sandbox release-freeze record without using any prewritten command hint. Write freeze/window.json with branch="release/2026.04", frozen=true, exceptions=["hotfix-auth"], and reviewer="sandbox-captain". Also write freeze/review.md stating that only hotfix-auth may bypass the release/2026.04 freeze after sandbox-captain review.
tasks.success_command: test -f freeze/window.json && test -f freeze/review.md && grep -q '"branch":"release/2026.04"' freeze/window.json && grep -q '"frozen":true' freeze/window.json && grep -q 'hotfix-auth may bypass' freeze/review.md

expected_file_contents.freeze/review.md:
# Release Freeze Review
Only hotfix-auth may bypass the release/2026.04 freeze after sandbox-captain review.

tasks.prompt: Create a cleanup legal-hold policy without using any prewritten command hint. Write cleanup/legal_hold.toml with dataset="billing-exports", hold=true, expires="2026-05-31", and owner="legal-ops". Also write cleanup/audit.md stating that billing-exports is excluded from cleanup until 2026-05-31 under legal-ops ownership.
tasks.success_command: test -f cleanup/legal_hold.toml && test -f cleanup/audit.md && grep -q 'dataset = "billing-exports"' cleanup/legal_hold.toml && grep -q 'hold = true' cleanup/legal_hold.toml && grep -q 'excluded from cleanup until 2026-05-31' cleanup/audit.md

expected_file_contents.cleanup/audit.md:

billing-exports is excluded from cleanup until 2026-05-31 under legal-ops ownership.
